findings.title: terminalReviewRefusal crashes on an unreadable review-rounds path
findings.action: Treat any readdir error other than ENOENT as a refusal
findings.disposition_rationale: readdir failures other than ENOENT now refuse with exit 1; covered by a test that makes review-rounds a file.

findings.finding_id: plugin/skills/faff/bin/lib/evidence.js::event appended before the file leaves the chain ahead of a failed file write
findings.title: Event appended before the file leaves the chain ahead of a failed file write
findings.action: State in the write-failure message that the evidence-terminal-only event was already recorded
findings.disposition_rationale: The event-first order is the spec's chosen design (spec review round 1): a trace without a file fails the merge floor closed. The write-failure message now says the event was already recorded.

occurrences.title: Event appended before the file leaves the chain ahead of a failed file write
